user.title: Samsung Washer — SmartThings App Credentials
user.description: Enter the OAuth client credentials from your SmartThings app.

tokens.title: Samsung Washer — Access Tokens
tokens.description:
Paste the access token and refresh token. Get these by authorising manually in Insomnia:
1. Open the SmartThings authorize URL in a browser
2. Log in and approve
3. Exchange the code in Insomnia using Basic Auth

error.invalid_access_token: Access token is invalid or expired — get a fresh one.

cycles.title: Samsung Washer — Rename Cycles
cycles.description: Edit the display name for each cycle. The field labels show the cycle code.
